plan.title: Add a bounded Spring Boot pack and public contract example

criteria.description: The pack loads all four surfaces with prerequisites and namespaces.
Public fixtures expose API removal, route, migration and configuration-key changes without configuration values.
Invalid, missing or stale extractor output fails rather than reusing prior artifacts.

limitations: Spring Boot 3.5.16 Spring MVC public example only; Java 21 and Maven are external prerequisites.
Explicit contract/extra profiles, selected synthetic API probes, SQL file hashes and properties keys; not complete API coverage or live database schema introspection.
Python standard library adapter on macOS/Linux; no new Go dependencies or automatic tool installation.
Default Go tests exercise public fixtures; actual Maven smoke is recorded separately.
No implicit surface-to-mode policy or authenticated human approval.
